description: A shell script for testing Git worktree operations involving skip-worktree flags, including setup, read-tree updates, index setup, and sparse checkout scenarios.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Prepares the repository with a file marked as absent and skip-worktree.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Prepares the repository with a file marked as dirty and skip-worktree.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies the status of the dirty file setup.
